attn_weights1 = torch.matmul(query_states1, past_key.transpose(1, 2)) / 0.0078125

attn_output1 = torch.matmul(attn_weights1, past_value)

attn_output1 = attn_output1.transpose(0, 1)

return attn_output1

# TorchNPU

PyTorch Adapter Plugin for Ascend NPU

English | 简体中文

Supported Versions · Installation · Quick Start · Compatibility · Support · Contributing · Docs · Community

## Overview

As the core component of the Ascend for PyTorch community, TorchNPU is a deep learning adapter plugin built by Ascend for PyTorch, enabling the PyTorch framework to directly invoke Ascend NPU and providing developers with the powerful compute capabilities of Ascend AI processors.

Ascend is a full-stack AI computing infrastructure for industry applications and services based on Huawei Ascend AI processors and software. For more information about Ascend, see Ascend Community.

## Key Features

TorchNPU fully inherits and reuses extensive mature capabilities from upstream PyTorch, and on this foundation provides deep adaptation and optimization for Ascend NPU. 
## Latest News

  * 📢 [2026-06-30] Advance notice on standardized naming conventions for Ascend for PyTorch community components. 🔗 Learn more
  * 📢 [2026-04-30] TorchNPU 26.0.0 released, adding support for PyTorch 2.10.0, Python 3.13, P2P communication group dispatch, DTensor strategy extensions, and more. 🔗 Learn more

## Supported PyTorch Versions

This branch adapts to multiple PyTorch versions from a single source tree. The PyTorch versions it currently supports are declared in version.txt, which is the single source of truth and is updated as new versions are adapted.

For the compatibility matrix of released packages (TorchNPU / PyTorch / CANN / Python), please refer to Compatibility.

## Installation

### From Binary
